convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'CenterOfGravity' custom indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, etc.). Both must be manually recreated or ported.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timestamp

other_exits: Sell position closed when CenterOfGravity buffer1[SignalBar]==1 (buy signal)
Buy position closed when CenterOfGravity buffer1[SignalBar]==2 (sell signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM value = fixed lot size (absolute value), positive MM value = deposit fraction for money management

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic reads 2 values from CenterOfGravity buffer 1: SigValue[0] at index SignalBar and SigValue[1] at index SignalBar+1. Buy signal: SigValue[1]==1 AND SigValue[0]==2 (crossover from sell zone to buy zone). Sell signal: SigValue[1]==2 AND SigValue[0]==1 (crossover from buy zone to sell zone). BuyPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean input gates that independently control permission for each action. When SignalBar==0, signals are recalculated every tick instead of only on new bars. Signal timestamps are set to last bar date + TimeShiftSec (i.e. start of next bar). Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on first tick after insufficient data.
python_conversion_notes: The CenterOfGravity indicator is custom and must be reimplemented in Python - it is an Ehlers Center of Gravity oscillator with signal line smoothing. The indicator outputs two buffers: buffer 0 is the CG line, buffer 1 appears to be a discrete signal buffer (1=buy zone, 2=sell zone). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose which wrap position management, money management (MM parameter: negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction), SL/TP setting, and deviation handling. These must all be ported. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points likely assume 5-digit pricing (100/200 pips) - verify digit adjustment logic in TradeAlgorithms.mqh. The EA operates on-bar (new bar guard) with SignalBar=1 default meaning signals come from the previous completed bar.
